output.question: Who is Goldman Sachs' CTO?

passages.quote: John Madsen is currently Chief Technology Officer and Head of Core Engineering at Goldman Sachs.
Goldman Sachs has named tech veteran John Madsen as its chief technology officer, Business Insider has learned.
Dinesh will also serve as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering.

output.answer: John Madsen is listed as Goldman Sachs’ Chief Technology Officer and Head of Core Engineering, including in a leadership listing updated September 17, 2026. Goldman Sachs separately announced Dinesh Keswani as CTO of The Core Engineering on September 3, 2026; that release does not identify him as the firm’s overall CTO.
caveats: The current listing identifying Madsen is secondary. Goldman Sachs’ more recent primary announcement gives Keswani the CTO title for The Core Engineering, but does not explicitly confirm who holds the firmwide CTO title.
missing_fields: A recent Goldman Sachs primary-source confirmation of the firmwide CTO title
